items.name: build-your-own-x
items.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
items.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

items.name: vaultwarden
items.summary: Vaultwarden 是一个轻量级、自托管的密码管理器服务器，兼容 Bitwarden 客户端。它解决了官方服务器资源占用高的问题，让你在低功耗设备（如树莓派）上也能运行。核心优势在于用 Rust 编写，内存和 CPU 消耗极低，且完全开源。通过 Docker 几分钟即可部署，支持多设备同步密码、自动填充等功能。适合个人或小团队，既享受 Bitwarden 生态的便利，又保持数据完全自主可控。你可以用它搭建家庭或团队的密码管理中枢，无需依赖任何云服务。
items.summary_en: Vaultwarden is a lightweight, self-hosted password manager server compatible with Bitwarden clients. It solves the need for a private, resource-efficient alternative to the official Bitwarden server. Written in Rust, it uses minimal memory and CPU, making it ideal for low-power devices like Raspberry Pi. You can deploy it via Docker in minutes, sync passwords across devices, and maintain full control over your data. Perfect for individuals or small teams seeking a secure, open-source password management solution without cloud dependencies.

items.name: typescript-go
items.summary: typescript-go 是微软将 TypeScript 编译器从 TypeScript/JavaScript 原生移植到 Go 语言的实验性项目。其核心目标是利用 Go 的并发模型和高效运行时，大幅提升编译性能并降低内存占用。技术亮点在于：将性能关键的基础设施用系统级语言重写，可在保持完全兼容的前提下获得显著加速。开发者可以关注开发进展、参与贡献或测试早期构建版本，体验更快的类型检查和编译速度。这一项目展示了如何通过语言迁移优化现有工具链，为大型代码库的构建效率带来质的提升。
items.summary_en: typescript-go is a staging repository for Microsoft's experimental native port of the TypeScript compiler from TypeScript/JavaScript to Go. This project aims to significantly improve compiler performance and reduce memory usage by leveraging Go's concurrency and efficient runtime. The key technical insight is that rewriting performance-critical infrastructure in a systems language like Go can yield substantial speedups while maintaining full compatibility. Developers can follow the development, contribute, or test early builds to experience faster type-checking and compilation in their workflows.

items.name: osv-scanner
items.summary: OSV-Scanner 是一款基于 OSV.dev 数据库的开源漏洞扫描器，专门用于检测项目依赖中的已知安全漏洞。其核心优势在于直接对接 OSV 数据库，无需维护本地漏洞源即可获取最新、准确的扫描结果。工具采用 Go 语言编写，支持 npm、PyPI、Go 模块等多种生态系统的依赖格式。实际使用中，你可以通过命令行快速扫描项目的 lockfile 或 SBOM 文件，或将其集成到 CI/CD 流水线中实现自动化安全审计。这种设计让开发者能以极低门槛持续监控依赖风险，尤其适合需要快速集成漏洞检查的团队。
items.summary_en: OSV-Scanner is a vulnerability scanner that uses the open-source OSV.dev database to find known vulnerabilities in project dependencies. Its key strength is direct integration with the OSV database, providing accurate and up-to-date results without relying on local vulnerability feeds. Written in Go, it supports multiple ecosystems like npm, PyPI, and Go modules. You can run it as a CLI tool or integrate it into CI/CD pipelines to automatically check for vulnerabilities in your lockfiles or SBOMs, making security auditing simple and fast.

items.name: DeepEP
items.summary: DeepEP 是专为混合专家模型（MoE）设计的专家并行通信库，旨在降低专家间路由 token 的高通信开销。其核心创新在于基于 CUDA 和 RDMA 的低延迟、高吞吐全交换通信原语，针对 GPU 集群优化。集成后，可显著减少专家间空闲等待时间，支持更多专家扩展；推理阶段加速 token 分发与合并。该库为大规模 MoE 系统提供开箱即用的高性能通信方案，使开发者更专注于模型设计。
items.summary_en: DeepEP is a communication library designed for expert-parallel training and inference in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, solving the high communication overhead of routing tokens across experts. Its key innovation is a low-latency, high-throughput all-to-all communication primitive optimized for GPU clusters, leveraging CUDA and RDMA for efficient data transfer. You can integrate DeepEP into your MoE training pipeline to reduce idle time and scale to more experts, or use it for inference to accelerate token dispatch and combine operations.

items.name: Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct
items.summary: Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct 是一个轻量级的 20 亿参数视觉语言模型，能够同时理解图像和文本，实现多模态对话与推理。其技术核心在于高效的跨模态融合架构，在保持较强推理能力的同时，模型尺寸足够小，适合在资源受限的边缘设备上部署。开发者可通过 Hugging Face Transformers 直接调用该模型，应用于视觉问答、图像描述生成，或构建能够结合视觉内容与文本输入的交互式 AI 助手，为实际场景提供灵活的多模态解决方案。
items.summary_en: Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct is a lightweight 2-billion-parameter vision-language model that enables conversational AI to understand and reason about both images and text simultaneously. Its technical innovation lies in efficient multimodal fusion architecture that maintains strong reasoning capabilities while being small enough for edge deployment. Developers can use it through Hugging Face Transformers for applications like visual question answering, image captioning, or building interactive AI assistants that process visual content alongside text inputs.

items.name: gemma-4-E2B-it
items.summary: Gemma-4-E2B-it是谷歌开源的任意模态输入输出模型，能同时处理文本、图像和代码。其核心技术是E2B（端到端双向）架构，通过统一注意力机制实现跨模态的深度理解，无需传统分离式编码器。你可以在Hugging Face上直接调用Transformers库加载模型，用于视觉问答、图像描述生成或根据混合输入编写代码等场景。尝试用官方推理脚本快速搭建多模态聊天机器人或自动化文档工具，体验真正的any-to-any能力。
items.summary_en: Gemma-4-E2B-it is Google's open-source any-to-any multimodal model that processes and generates text, images, and code within a single framework. Its key innovation is the 'E2B' (End-to-End Bidirectional) architecture, enabling seamless cross-modal understanding without separate encoders. You can deploy it via Hugging Face Transformers for tasks like visual question answering, image captioning, or code generation from mixed inputs. Try it with the provided inference script to build multimodal chatbots or automated documentation tools.

items.name: bert-base-uncased
items.summary: BERT-base-uncased是一种双向语言理解模型，通过同时分析上下文捕捉完整语义，克服了传统单向模型的局限。其核心技术为掩码语言建模，训练时随机遮盖词汇并预测内容，从而学习深层语言规律。该模型可通过Hugging Face库加载，支持微调实现文本分类或问答功能，也可直接提取词向量用于语义相似度计算，为自然语言处理提供基础能力。

items.name: electra-base-discriminator
items.summary: ELECTRA-base-discriminator是一种基于判别式预训练的Transformer模型，通过将掩码语言建模改为区分真实与生成器产生的替代标记，显著提升训练效率。其核心创新是使用小型生成器产生替代标记，再由判别器识别真假，比BERT等模型训练更快且性能强劲。开发者可通过Hugging Face库微调该模型，应用于文本分类、命名实体识别或问答任务，特别适合计算资源有限但需要高质量语言理解的场景。

items.name: paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2
items.summary: paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2 是一个紧凑的多语言句子编码模型，专门解决跨语言语义理解难题，支持50多种语言的文本相似度计算。它通过知识蒸馏技术将大型多语言Transformer的能力压缩到轻量级12层架构中，同时保持跨语言语义对齐特性，让模型在不同语言间准确捕捉相同含义。开发者可直接用它构建多语言语义搜索系统、实现跨语言文档分类，或作为特征提取器用于下游NLP任务，只需输入任意支持语言的文本即可获得高质量的语义向量表示。
